intended_object: The discrete average (1/T)·Σ_{n=0}^{T-1} f(n) of a real-valued function f over the integers in [0, T), as stated in the docstring.
explanation: The body (∑ n ∈ Finset.range T, f n) / T is exactly the average over {0,…,T−1}. At T = 0 it gives the standard junk value 0/0 = 0, and nothing depends on another value. It equals Mathlib's Finset.expect (Finset.range T) f, including at T = 0, and the library uses Finset.expect alongside it (e.g. integerAverage_complete_residues). The index set [0,T) is part of the object itself. The real codomain is the natural setting for how it is used: the surrounding lemmas take absolute values and squares and bound errors like m/T. So this is a faithful local name for one specific average, not an artificially narrowed general construction.
